brentwood.snapshot: Brentwood is a busy Essex commuter town where full fibre is going in fast and structured cabling keeps its business parks wired. Build contractors and structured-cabling firms run fleets of engineers on trade accounts and buy branded kit through procurement, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. We run both routes side by side so the fleet and the lone installer are kitted alike.
brentwood.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Brentwood and Essex
s1loc: Brentwood sits in the middle of a heavy Essex full-fibre build. Openreach has invested millions extending its Full Fibre network across the town and reaching the majority of properties, and Project Gigabit work is now targeting urban neighbourhoods and business parks around Brentwood, Chelmsford and Basildon that the early commercial build skipped. County Broadband has been pushing fibre through the wider rural Essex fringe, and the major build contractors field crews through Hutton, Shenfield, Warley and Pilgrims Hatch laying duct, blowing fibre and connecting cabinets and customer premises right across the district.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial scene. Childerditch Industrial Park off the A127 near Little Warley runs to dozens of acres of logistics and industrial units, the Hutton Industrial Estate sits off the A12, and Brentwood Trade Park and the town-centre offices keep structured-cabling and CCTV firms busy in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre. With the M25 at Junction 29 minutes away and warehousing serving London Gateway and the east-coast ports, installers wire distribution sheds, offices, schools and multi-site businesses across Brentwood the year round.
